headword: {十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき}

definitions.gloss: thirteenth death anniversary; memorial service held in the twelfth year after a death
definitions.explanation: A Buddhist memorial service marking the thirteenth observance of someone's death, held twelve calendar years after the death (counted inclusively).

examples.japanese: {母|はは}の{十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき}を{迎|むか}えた。
examples.english: We reached my mother's thirteenth-year memorial.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}は{祖父|そふ}の{十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき}の{年|とし}だ。
examples.english: This is the year of my grandfather's thirteenth-year memorial.

examples.japanese: {十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき}は{家族|かぞく}だけで{静|しず}かに{執|と}り{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: We held the thirteenth-year memorial quietly with just family.

notes:
Like other {回忌|かいき}, counted inclusively: the death year is year 1, so {十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき} falls twelve calendar years after the death. By this stage attendance is usually limited to immediate family.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき}{法要|ほうよう}: thirteenth-year memorial service
- {十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき}を{営|いとな}む: to hold the thirteenth-year service
- {十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき}を{迎|むか}える: for the thirteenth-year memorial to come around

MEMORIAL SERVICE SEQUENCE:
- {七回忌|ななかいき}: 6 years after death
- {十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき}: 12 years after death
- {十七回忌|じゅうしちかいき}: 16 years after death
- {三十三回忌|さんじゅうさんかいき}: 32 years after death (often the final service)
